title: Green Rewards Card: Viewing Your Monthly Environmental Impact Dashboard
summary: Explains how to access the Green Rewards Card Environmental Impact dashboard, select a monthly reporting view, and interpret emissions overview, offsets applied (running total computed using $0.06), tree progress (eligible spend toward $3,000), and net impact (emissions minus offsets). Includes available filters/views, export options (summary for stakeholders and detailed export for analysis/reconciliation), and troubleshooting steps when purchases don’t appear.
faqs: How do I open the Environmental Impact section and choose the correct monthly reporting view?
What does the dashboard show for emissions, offsets, tree progress, and net impact?
How can I filter the dashboard by merchant category or cardholder, and compare to previous periods?
What export options are available (summary vs detailed) and what are they for?
My purchase isn’t reflected—what troubleshooting steps should I try first?
What if the purchase appears under the wrong impact category—how do I verify merchant category alignment and settings?
keywords: Tree progress (advances with eligible spend toward $3,000)
Toggle views (compare to previous periods on same monthly cycle)
Confirm merchant category aligns with sustainability mapping
